train_meta.description: IF trained on baseline+asset past windows only (normality anchors). Daily scoring compares each sat (esp. suspects) to that baseline. Hard thr calibrated as max(0.50, p95 of normality-anchor scores), per orbit when possible. Does NOT overwrite isolation_forest.joblib (priority pipeline). Palantir-style: Data→Quant→IF Inference→priority (XGB/pairs)→LLM explain.

calibration.paper_note: Hard hit if anomaly_score >= thr. thr = max(0.50, p95 of IF scores on baseline+asset training windows). Per-orbit thr used when available.
